verdict.rationale: The docs show results are retrieved programmatically through a backend API, via webhook or polling, with webhook events for workflow status changes. Discrete report types (Document, Facial Similarity, Watchlist, Known Faces) act as risk signals an automated flow could consume. However, nothing in the evidence describes the result payload: no structured result fields, sub-result breakdowns or failure-reason codes that an agent could branch on. Missing for 10: documented result/sub-result schema, explicit failure reason codes, risk scores or breakdown fields, hands-on corroboration of machine-readable outcomes.
